name: Research Stays for University Academics and Scientists
amount: Monthly research allowance + travel allowance (see website for current rates)
eligibility: University teachers / established academics, normally with a doctorate, employed at a university or research institute in their home country; host invitation from a German university or research institute
eligibility_note: Offered worldwide via the DAAD scholarship database with country-specific deadlines (DAAD Pakistan publishes them). Official DAAD pages returned HTTP 503 on verification day; details confirmed via DAAD-derived call texts (ECR Central, university notices). Re-check the Pakistan entry in the DAAD database.
deadline: Annual (check site) – deadline varies by country; portal opens ~6 weeks before deadline
how_to_apply_tip: Secure a written invitation/supervision confirmation from a German host first; search the DAAD database with 'Pakistan' as country of origin to get the exact deadline.

name: Re-invitation Programme for Former Scholarship Holders
amount: Monthly allowance + travel allowance (see website)
eligibility: Only former DAAD research/study scholarship holders funded for at least 6 months, or EPOS graduates; working in academia in home country
eligibility_note: Open to DAAD alumni worldwide; country-specific deadlines. Conditional on being a former DAAD scholarship holder. Official DAAD page returned HTTP 503 on verification day; terms confirmed via Research in Germany listing.
how_to_apply_tip: Only relevant if you held a DAAD scholarship (e.g., for your PhD in Germany); line up the same or a new German host and apply via the DAAD portal.

name: JSPS Invitational Fellowships for Research in Japan (Short-term)
funder: Japan Society for the Promotion of Science (JSPS)
amount: JPY 18,000 per day + round-trip economy airfare + travel insurance + up to JPY 150,000 research support (host)
eligibility: Full-time researcher at a foreign university/institute at a position equivalent to assistant professor or above, OR 6+ years since PhD; host researcher in Japan applies
eligibility_note: JSPS: candidates must be citizens or permanent residents of a country with diplomatic relations with Japan (Pakistan qualifies).
how_to_apply_tip: The Japanese host submits (forms S-1 to S-3); host institutions set internal deadlines up to a month earlier than JSPS's 23 Apr 2027 round (arrival Oct 2027–Mar 2028). Being an assistant professor in Pakistan meets the career rule.

name: ICTP Junior Associates
funder: Abdus Salam International Centre for Theoretical Physics (ICTP)
amount: 3 round-trip travel fares over 6 years + ICTP hospitality during visits
duration: 6-year appointment; 3 visits of 30-60 days (max 180 days total)
eligibility: PhD holders aged 35 or under with main affiliation at an institute in a developing country; fields include Scientific Computing, AI and Data Science (ICOMP)
eligibility_note: ICTP: open to scientists whose main affiliation is in a developing country (Pakistan is a developing country per ICTP/UN lists).
how_to_apply_tip: Needs two recommendation letters from senior scientists (preferably outside your institute); name the ICOMP/Scientific Computing, AI & Data Science section as your target.

name: ICTP Regular Associates
funder: Abdus Salam International Centre for Theoretical Physics (ICTP)
amount: 3 round-trip travel fares over 6 years + ICTP hospitality during visits
duration: 6-year appointment; 3 visits of 30-60 days (max 180 days total)
eligibility: PhD holders aged 36-45 affiliated with an institute in a developing country; includes Scientific Computing, AI and Data Science
eligibility_note: ICTP: main affiliation with a scientific institute in a developing country.
how_to_apply_tip: Use this instead of Junior Associates if you are 36+; plan visits of at least 30 days to qualify for the travel fare.

name: Training and Research in Italian Laboratories (TRIL)
amount: EUR 1,500/month (PhD <5 yrs) or EUR 1,600/month (PhD >5 yrs) + prepaid travel ticket + medical insurance
duration: A few months to 12 months (max 24 incl. extensions)
eligibility: Nationals of and residents in a developing country with at least a Master's; physics-related fields incl. computational physics, wireless ICT/IoT, digital fabrication
eligibility_note: ICTP: applicants must be nationals of a developing country and live in one when selected; developed-country individuals are not eligible.
how_to_apply_tip: Find an Italian lab among ICTP's 400+ partner institutes first and get them to agree to co-fund; frame AI work within computational physics or ICT/IoT.

name: TÜBİTAK 2221 Fellowships for Visiting Scientists and Scientists on Sabbatical Leave
amount: Up to TRY 81,000/month (visiting scientist) + one round-trip airfare + health insurance for 3-12 month stays
eligibility: PhD holders working at universities/research institutions abroad; host scientist (full-time, PhD) at a Turkish university or TÜBİTAK centre applies
eligibility_note: TÜBİTAK page states no nationality restriction; aimed at Turkish and other scientists working abroad.
how_to_apply_tip: Four calls a year (next window 2-30 Nov 2026). Register on ARBİS with your passport name; the Turkish host writes the proposal (in Turkish) and submits it.

name: TWAS-FAPESP Postdoctoral Fellowship Programme for Developing Countries
amount: FAPESP postdoctoral fellowship stipend (see call document)
eligibility: PhD within the last 7 years in natural, applied or social sciences (incl. engineering and mathematical sciences); no age limit; host in São Paulo State
eligibility_note: TWAS: open to nationals of 'all developing countries' (TWAS list includes Pakistan).
how_to_apply_tip: Supervisors register expressions of interest by 1 Nov 2026 and the list is published 1 Dec 2026; pick a CS/engineering supervisor from that list, who submits the full proposal by 1 Apr 2027.

name: TWAS-TÜBİTAK Postdoctoral Fellowship Programme
amount: Monthly allowance for accommodation/living + private health insurance (TÜBİTAK)
eligibility: PhD holders, max age 45, natural and applied sciences; host at a Turkish university or TÜBİTAK centre
eligibility_note: TWAS: open to nationals of developing countries in the South; not one of the Pakistan-hosted programmes that exclude Pakistanis.
how_to_apply_tip: The 2026 call is closed; get a preliminary acceptance letter from the Turkish host in the same year you apply. TWAS allows only one TWAS/OWSD application per calendar year.

name: Royal Society International Exchanges (Global rounds)
amount: Up to GBP 3,000 (single visit ≤3 months); up to GBP 6,000 (1 yr) or GBP 12,000 (2 yrs) for multiple visits
duration: Single visit up to 3 months, or multiple visits over 1-2 years
eligibility: PhD or equivalent; UK-based scientist with contract applies jointly with overseas collaborator; natural sciences incl. computing; new collaborations only
eligibility_note: Royal Society: Global rounds accept collaborations with 'any country or territory outside the UK'.
deadline: Annual – rounds usually close June and September
how_to_apply_tip: The UK partner is the lead applicant; it must be a new collaboration (not a former supervisor/colleague). Both partners must be based in their countries when applying.

name: DFG Initiation of International Collaboration (guest visits)
amount: Travel + DFG standard maintenance allowance for guests (see DFG form 1.813)
duration: Guest visit up to 3 months, within 12 months of approval
eligibility: German-based researcher with PhD applies; guests from abroad are generally doctorate holders
eligibility_note: DFG page names no country restriction for guests; the German host applies on your behalf.
how_to_apply_tip: Ask a German collaborator to submit a short proposal for your guest visit; it is also usable for repeat visits to build a joint DFG project.

name: Ernst Mach Grant – Worldwide
funder: OeAD (Austria's Agency for Education and Internationalisation)
amount: Monthly grant (see website) + help with insurance and accommodation; supplementary own funds needed
eligibility: Young researchers (PhD students and postdocs) of all disciplines, aged 35 or under; Austrian host
eligibility_note: OeAD: 'young researchers from all disciplines and countries (except Austria)'.
how_to_apply_tip: Postdocs must show employment at their home university; get a supervision letter from an Austrian host (e.g., TU Wien, JKU Linz) before 1 Dec.

name: ERCIM Alain Bensoussan Fellowship Programme
funder: European Research Consortium for Informatics and Mathematics (ERCIM)
amount: Partial funding for living expenses at the host institute (see website)
eligibility: Recent PhD holders in computer science, informatics, applied mathematics
eligibility_note: ERCIM: fellowships 'for PhD holders from all over the world'.
how_to_apply_tip: Register on the site for round alerts and contact a researcher at an ERCIM member institute (e.g., Inria, CWI, SINTEF) before applying.

name: CAS President's International Fellowship Initiative (PIFI) – Visiting Scientists / Postdoctoral
amount: See website
duration: See website (past calls: 1-12 months for visiting scientists)
eligibility: Researchers worldwide nominated by a CAS host; visiting-scientist category usually expects established researchers
eligibility_note: PIFI is 'open to scientific research personnel from around the world', but the official site says it is being optimised and applications are TEMPORARILY SUSPENDED.
how_to_apply_tip: PIFI takes no direct applications: a CAS host must nominate you. Ask a CAS collaborator whether a 2027 batch is open at their institute.

name: ANSO Visiting Scientist Fellowship (Category II)
funder: Alliance of International Science Organizations (ANSO) / CAS
amount: Monthly allowance by rank (see website)
eligibility: Scholars at institutions outside mainland China, incl. postdocs/assistant professors; CAS host submits
eligibility_note: ANSO: open to applicants from institutions outside the Chinese mainland; no country list. Page shows the 2025 call (deadline 24 Apr), so the next call is unconfirmed.
how_to_apply_tip: Your CAS host researcher submits the application; do not send materials to the ANSO Secretariat.

name: Simons Institute Programmatic Research Fellowships
funder: Simons Institute for the Theory of Computing, UC Berkeley
amount: Fellowship stipend (see website)
duration: One semester program (~4 months; e.g., Diffusion Generative Modeling I, 30 Aug-17 Dec 2027)
eligibility: Early-career researchers within about 5 years of PhD in theoretical CS / ML theory
eligibility_note: No nationality restriction stated on the official pages.
how_to_apply_tip: Apply to the semester program closest to your research (cover letter, CV and research statement in one PDF, plus 3 referees).

name: IPAM Long Program Participation – Artificial Intelligence in Materials Science (Fall 2027)
funder: Institute for Pure and Applied Mathematics (IPAM), UCLA (NSF)
amount: Housing and travel support for long-program participants (amount see website)
eligibility: Researchers at all career stages; early-career participants encouraged
eligibility_note: No nationality restriction stated on the IPAM page.
deadline: See website (application portal not yet open)
how_to_apply_tip: Watch the program page and apply as soon as the form opens; stress your ML for scientific modeling work.

name: Erasmus+ International Credit Mobility – Staff Mobility (KA171)
amount: Travel + daily subsistence at Erasmus+ unit rates (see website)
eligibility: Academic/admin staff of a partner HEI with an inter-institutional agreement with a European university
eligibility_note: Programme Guide covers mobility with non-associated third countries (Asia region); the EC Pakistan Erasmus+ factsheet confirms Pakistani institutions take part in ICM.
deadline: Rolling (institution-level calls; EU HEIs apply to National Agencies by 19 Feb each year)
how_to_apply_tip: Ask your university's international office which EU partners hold KA171 projects with Pakistan; teaching visits require at least 8 hours of teaching per week.

name: MSCA Staff Exchanges (secondments)
amount: EUR unit costs per person-month of secondment (see call)
eligibility: Staff of consortium partner organisations (any career stage) actively engaged in the project
eligibility_note: Pakistan is on the Horizon Europe list of low/middle-income countries automatically eligible for funding, so Pakistani partner staff secondments can be funded.
how_to_apply_tip: You cannot apply alone: join an EU-led consortium as a Pakistani partner. Contact EU AI groups now, since the 2027 call is expected to open 15 Dec 2026.

name: CNRS–Imperial Global Researcher Short Visits in AI in Science
funder: Imperial College London I-X / CNRS–Imperial 'Abraham de Moivre' IRL (Schmidt AI in Science)
amount: GBP 950/week subsistence + up to GBP 1,500 flights + visa fee + insurance contribution
eligibility: Researchers/faculty at universities or research centres in LDCs/LMICs (OECD list); need link to a CNRS-Imperial collaboration and an Imperial host
eligibility_note: Open to OECD-listed LDCs and LMICs (Pakistan is a lower-middle-income country on the OECD DAC list); country not named explicitly.
deadline: Annual (check site) – 2026 call closed 31 May 2026; a second call may open if funds remain
how_to_apply_tip: The scheme runs over 3 years with up to 4 visits a year; contact an I-X Imperial supervisor now so you are ready for the next call.
